page.overview:
Who is Cow?

Adult:Height: 1.4 BlocksWidth: 0.9 Blocks Baby:Height: 0.7 BlocksWidth: 0.45 Blocks : Adult:Height: 1.3 BlocksWidth: 0.9 Blocks Baby:Height: 0.65 BlocksWidth: 0.45 Blocks

A cow is a passive mob and a source of leather, beef and milk.

There are three different variants that spawn depending on the biome that the Cow spawns in.

Cows spawn above grass blocks in small herds during world generation or individually afterwards. Their spawn rate varies per biome.
